new_findings: Rollback target semantics must be fixed before selector comparison: earliest causal origin, first sufficient intervention point, latest rescue-capable point/point-of-commitment, and intended semantic version are distinct objectives.
REFLECT supplies intervention-verified localization evidence but confounds target choice with diagnosis, multiple probes and extra compute.
AgenTracer supplies a learned static attribution arm trained from counterfactual data but lacks inference-time causal verification per target.
ChronoMem motivates set-valued target output and abstention because exact historical-version Recall@1 remains modest despite explicit version history.
Causal Agent Replay exposes stochastic run-forward total-effect confounding, motivates latest rescue-capable point-of-commitment, replay action-match metrics and same-policy control branches.
gap: No located software/tool/GUI study fixes target objective, alarm, candidate set, restore/carry-forward, model, probe policy and post-intervention budget while varying only historical target selector and measuring final live task success.
exact_next_action: Search matched-budget software/tool-agent studies comparing earliest-cause, latest-rescue/point-of-commitment and latest-safe targets; inspect learned tracers for calibrated top-k/abstention and healthy-trajectory disruption; add target semantics, probe budget, Scope@k, action-match and replay-noise controls to the strict selector harness.
